title: Fourth-order Taylor remainder bound
statement:
Let $\psi\colon\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be four times continuously differentiable, and suppose $C\ge0$ and $|\psi^{(4)}(t)|\le C$ for every $t\in\mathbb R$. For all $a,b\in\mathbb R$,
\[\left|\psi(a+b)-\sum_{j=0}^{3}\frac{\psi^{(j)}(a)}{j!}b^j\right|\le\frac{C}{24}b^4.\]
hypotheses_covered: $\psi\colon\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ is four times continuously differentiable.
replaced: Let $\psi\colon\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be $C^4$ and let $C\ge0$ satisfy $|\psi^{(4)}(t)|\le C$ for all real $t$. For all real $a,b$, $\left|\psi(a+b)-\sum_{j=0}^3\psi^{(j)}(a)b^j/j!\right|\le Cb^4/24$.
